title: Just A Cold Spot, Not Ghosts

sentences.text: Hmph. The sensor data only indicates a.
16.9 °C in the living room between 04:20 and 06:00, which was significantly below the expected range of.
17.7 °C to 18.6 °C. Since there are no other correlating events, I think it was probably just a draft or maybe an open window.
